title: Why people start a business
log: 2026-11-01T08:04:31Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new
2026-11-01T08:14:01Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: The bank card is broader than the new point: it centres on weighing reasons against skills, money and risk, and it does not teach the 'meet a need they have spotted' reason, while its examples and Business Studies framing are NSW-based.

draft.title: Why people start a business
card: People start a business for different reasons. Many have more than one.
being their own boss. The owner decides what to sell, when to work and how to run things.
earning income above the costs of running the business. The owner hopes to make more than they would working for someone else.
using a skill, such as baking or plumbing, or meeting a need the owner has spotted, such as no café near a new housing estate.
draft.remember: People start a business to be independent, earn a profit, use a skill or meet a need.

a.q: Tom is a qualified electrician. He leaves his employer to start his own business so he can choose his own jobs and hours. Which reason best fits this?
opts: Meeting a need he has spotted
Copying a business that already exists
a.why: Tom wants to choose his jobs and hours, which is independence. He does use a skill, but his stated aim is control over his work. A profit is never guaranteed, so that option is wrong.
a.clue: What does Tom say he wants to choose?

b.q: Priya notices that no shop in her Ballarat suburb sells fresh bread after 2 pm. She opens a bakery to fill this gap. Which reason for starting a business does this show?
opts: Meeting a need she has spotted
Using a skill she has trained in
Earning a profit from the business
b.why: Priya saw something local people lacked and set up a business to supply it. The story says nothing about her baking training or wanting independence. Profit may also matter to her, but the reason shown is the gap she spotted.
b.clue: What did Priya notice about the suburb before she opened?

b.best: Meeting a need she has spotted
